title: A Year of Building ELARA's Research Community
summary: Park reflects on a year of student research, community engagement, and international exchange.

sources.label: Read Chorong Park's original LinkedIn post

paragraphs.text: Chorong Park marked a year of growth at ELARA Lab and the University of Houston in a September 8, 2026, reflection. Her update connects the lab's research on AI, robotics, and aging with the people and communities who have helped develop it.

The year included student research, community demonstrations, talks, and international exchanges. Park thanked the students, collaborators, and community partners who contributed ideas and time to this work.

Her reflection returned to a consistent research priority: developing technology that supports people's choices rather than taking those choices away. For the lab, community participation remains an important way to understand what meaningful assistance should look like.

Park also invited interest from students and collaborators across design, computing, robotics, psychology, healthcare, and care settings. The post looks toward a broader research community while recognizing the relationships already built.
The original collage brings together moments from community workshops, showing participants and researchers exploring companion robots together.
